cohort: A family from Turkey with two patients presenting with hypotonia, muscle weakness, and other anomalies, carrying a UBA1 gene variant inherited from their carrier mothers.
finding: A hemizygous pathogenic variant (c.1731C>T [p.Asn577Asn]) in the UBA1 gene was identified in two patients from Turkey, expanding the known phenotypic spectrum of SMAX2 to include pectus carinatum, medullary sponge kidney, and frontal cyst.
